name: Overlay Translator
tagline: Translate on-screen text instantly, right over the page
description:
Overlay Translator reads text straight off your screen and shows the translation right on top of it, in real time. It's great for games, visual novels, and manga written in a language you don't know, and it works without root access.

You can choose between on-device or cloud text recognition, pick from several translation services or offline AI models, and even have the text read aloud to you.
